title: Wave the Wheat | KEY.co
description_expanded: The capacious first level welcomes guests with not one, but two regal bedrooms, each adorned with a king-sized bed. One of these bedrooms is perfectly tailored for families, boasting an adjoining room with built-in bunk beds, ideal for accommodating young children. Additionally, this floor encompasses a spa-like private bathroom adorned with floor-to-ceiling marble, adding a touch of sophistication to the bathing experience. Both bedrooms conveniently open up to a delightful downstairs patio, further enhancing the indoor-outdoor flow. Designed to embrace the outdoors, our cottage offers ample space for al fresco dining and leisurely lounging, all within mere steps from the pristine sandy beach and a short stroll away from the vibrant town center. Seamlessly blending indoor and outdoor living, the residence features an abundance of floor-to-ceiling windows and glass doors in multiple rooms, allowing the natural light to permeate throughout the home, while providing guests with awe-inspiring panoramic views of the surrounding beauty.
